findings.title: unitHookLines calls hookFilePath outside the try, so one bad slice key throws in the tick
findings.detail:
hookFilePath throws 'not a slice key' for an unparsable slice. unitHooksChangedAt catches this, but unitHookLines (readUnitHooks) does not. Today every caller passes keys from the snapshot or the marker, so this cannot happen in practice.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Move the path computation inside the try, or leave it as is.

findings.title: appendHookTrace reads the previous mtime and then sets it in separate steps; concurrent hooks can race
findings.detail:
Two hooks that append at the same moment can leave the earlier fact's time on the file. This only shifts D4's window by the gap between them, and the file is diagnostic.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: None needed.

findings.title: Flaky under full-suite load: a 50 ms abort races the first frame
findings.detail:
It failed once in the full run (frames 0 vs 1) and passed 4 of 4 times alone. This diff only touches a fixture in this file, not this test.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: File as friction or a separate issue; it is not this slice's work.
